sections.extract: We are now prepared to make the crucial step towards understanding of mathematical structure behind eigenvalue models, which distinguishes their partition functions in the entire variety of arbitrary $N$-fold integrals. sections.title: The concept of integrability
sections.extract: Integrable structure of dynamical system implies that all the dynamical characteristics - solutions of equations of motion for a classical system and functional integrals for a quantum one - can be found exactly. sections.title: The notion of $\tau$-function
sections.extract: There are several different definitions of $\tau$-functions, but all of them are particular realizations of the following idea: $\tau$-function is a generating functional of all the correlation functions in the theory of free particles in 1+1 dimensions.
